title: Chapter 197: The Visitor Is Still Inside?!
html:
Looks like Xu Zhenzhen is hiding inside the female body prop.

A chill entered Chen Ge’s heart as he studied the prop. Who would imagine that the figure hanging beside the entrance concealed a real ghost? Every visitor had passed beneath her watchful gaze, and some had probably even touched her.

Now I have to answer another question. Why does the Tape Ghost want to find Xu Zhenzhen? Is there some kind of relationship between them, or was the Tape Ghost merely hungry and wanted to ingest another ghost?

Chen Ge did not know whether Xu Zhenzhen was a Baleful Specter or a lingering spirit. She appeared to regard Tian Teng Medical School as her home, and the attraction owed much of its popularity to her presence.

“No one was injured while Tian Teng Medical School operated in Xing Hai, so Xu Zhenzhen probably isn’t hostile to people.” Chen Ge would have preferred to leave her alone, but he could not control the Tape Ghost.

The man’s screams circled the hanging body. It began to shake as though sensing the approaching threat. Seconds later, an invisible force twisted the prop into an unnatural angle and tore off one leg.

The Tape Ghost is trying to swallow Xu Zhenzhen?

Perhaps it was his imagination, but pain crossed the mannequin’s face. At that instant, the Tape Ghost fell silent.

The man has transferred his pain to another ghost? Or has something happened here?

While Chen Ge was confused, the other leg of the mannequin was yanked off.

…

Outside, visitors whispered among themselves. The proprietor stared at the flat readings onscreen, his expression steadily darkening. The attraction’s soundproofing was imperfect, and screams had carried from within—but every one belonged to a woman.

A male visitor had entered, yet only women were screaming. In all his years of business, the proprietor had never encountered anything like it.

“So close.” He examined Chen Ge’s heart-rate trace. Its peak was ninety-six, just short of one hundred.

“Boss, how long will this activity of yours go on for? We’ve been waiting for almost thirty minutes already.”

Some of the visitors started to complain.

“Please be patient. Give it another five minutes. I’m sure the guy will be out soon.”

His reassurance lacked conviction. Under his breath, he muttered, “There’s a hidden storyline for courageous visitors. As a Haunted House owner, he must have discovered it. What’s taking so long?”

Just as the proprietor was mulling over this, the sound of rushing footsteps came out from the entrance.

“He’s coming out! Those footsteps are fast—he must be terrified.” The proprietor nodded with satisfaction, then glanced at the monitor and reassured himself. “No one keeps a heart rate below one hundred in a Haunted House. The machine must be malfunctioning.”

He took out the loudspeaker and turned to the crowd. “Our first visitor is coming out soon. We can compare how he was before he entered and how he is now, and then we’ll ask for his thoughts.”

Every eye turned toward the exit. The footsteps drew closer, and with a tremendous crash, someone burst through the wooden door and heavy curtain.

“Someone’s out!”

A woman in an oversized patient’s gown emerged. Black hair clung to her neck, cold sweat had destroyed her makeup, and from a distance, only her terror-bulging eyes were visible.

“Wait, isn’t that a woman?” the visitor closest to the door questioned. “This transformation is too huge!”

“Ah Rui?” Forgetting the loudspeaker in his hand, the proprietor shouted her name. A visitor had entered the attraction, yet one of the ghosts had fled first.

Another set of footsteps followed. Without prompting, everyone watched the exit. The curtain flew aside, and a male actor covered in fake blood sprinted out as though fleeing for his life. The instant he cleared the doorway, he collapsed.

“What’s going on?”

“Is this another activity organized by the Haunted House?”

The proprietor did not even have the chance to get over his initial shock. “Why is there another?”

The dark entrance revealed nothing of what was happening within. The proprietor left the stage and hurried toward the two actors, but before he reached them, the exit door slammed open again.

The crash was the loudest yet. Three actors—two men and one woman—spilled out together. All wore ghost makeup, but they looked thoroughly battered. Tears filled the smallest woman’s eyes, while half a severed hand and a model spleen protruded from her costume.

“What’s going on?” The proprietor asked the question that was on everyone’s mind.

“Boss Hu, there’s a real ghost inside! Xu Zhenzhen has returned!” The security guard was the only one still standing. He rushed over with a walkie-talkie. “Listen! Brother Lin and Ah Rui both saw her. Even Xiao Ye heard her. It’s real!”

“That isn’t important.” The proprietor shoved the radio aside and stared at his workers sprawled across the floor. “You’re all out here. Where is the visitor?”

“The visitor?” The security guard turned back to look, and he said uncertainly, “The visitor seems to still be in there?”

“Still inside?” The proprietor nearly fainted. In almost a decade of business, he had never seen every actor evacuate while a visitor continued the tour alone.

“Wait. You’re all outside, but he stayed in there alone. Does he think the real ghost is one of our actors?”

“That should be it. Xiao Ye said that the visitor has been following the ghost.”

The proprietor felt faint. What kind of monster had he invited into his attraction?

“Boss Hu, what should we do now? Call the cops?”

“Call the police on opening day? Do you want us shut down immediately?” The proprietor glared at him. “Get your equipment and come with me. The rest of you, off the floor. We’re going to find that man.”

The actors reluctantly stood. Loudspeaker in hand and suit immaculate, the proprietor led his battered team of “ghosts” cautiously back inside.
